mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, monomer_id, area_id, product_id, product_type, old_quantity, task_quantity, new_quantity, change_type, user_id, bool_status_enum
mapper.select:
SELECT a.create_time, a.update_time, a.bool_delete_enum, a.id, a.monomer_id, a.area_id, a.product_id, a.product_type, a.old_quantity, a.task_quantity, a.new_quantity, a.change_type, a.user_id, a.status, b.total_task_quantity, b.total_in_production_quantity FROM mes_building_abnormal a LEFT JOIN(SELECT product_id, product_type, SUM( task_quantity ) total_task_quantity, SUM( in_production_quantity ) total_in_production_quantity FROM mes_building_task GROUP BY product_id,product_type) b ON a.product_id =b.product_id and a.product_type=b.product_type
a.id =#{id}

SELECT ta.serial_number, factory.id 'factory.id', factory.`name` 'factory.name', workshop.id 'workshop.id', workshop.`name` 'workshop.name', production_line.id 'production_line.id', production_line.`name` 'production_line.name', project.id 'project.id', project.`name` 'project.name', project.short_name 'project.short_name', monomer.id 'monomer.id', monomer.`name` 'monomer.name', area.id 'area.id', area.`name` 'area.name', process.id process_id, process.`name` process_name, a.sequence, sum( a.complete_quantity ) complete_quantity FROM mes_building_task_process a LEFT JOIN mes_building_factory factory ON factory.id = a.factory_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop workshop ON workshop.id = a.workshop_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line production_line ON production_line.id = a.production_line_id LEFT JOIN contract_project project ON project.id = a.project_id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer monomer ON monomer.id = a.monomer_id LEFT JOIN plan_area area ON area.id = a.area_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process process ON process.id = a.process_id
LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part ta ON ta.id = a.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ta.id = a.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure ta ON ta.id = a.product_id
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble ta ON ta.id = a.product_id
where a.product_id=#{productId} and a.product_type=#{productType} GROUP BY ta.serial_number, factory.id, factory.`name`, workshop.id, workshop.`name`, production_line.id, production_line.`name`, project.id, project.`name`, project.short_name, monomer.id, monomer.`name`, area.id, area.`name`, process.id , process.`name`, a.sequence ORDER BY a.sequence asc

choose.when: SELECT c.user_name, sum(a.quantity)quantity, date(a.create_time)create_time, a.process_id, date(task.ask_complete_time)ask_complete_time, a.report_type, process.`name` process_name, factory.id 'factory.id', factory.`name` 'factory.name', workshop.id 'workshop.id', workshop.`name` 'workshop.name', production_line.id 'production_line.id', production_line.`name` 'production_line.name' FROM mes_building_produce_team_report a LEFT JOIN mes_building_task task ON a.task_id = task.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process process ON a.process_id = process.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link c ON a.team_id = c.team_id AND c.bool_leader_enum = 1 AND c.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_factory factory ON factory.id = task.factory_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop workshop ON workshop.id = task.workshop_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line production_line ON production_line.id = task.production_line_id where a.product_id=#{productId} and a.product_type=#{productType} GROUP BY c.user_name, date(a.create_time), a.process_id, date(task.ask_complete_time), a.report_type, process.`name`, factory.id , factory.`name`, workshop.id , workshop.`name` , production_line.id , production_line.`name`
choose.otherwise: SELECT task.task_quantity, date(task.ask_complete_time)ask_complete_time, task.in_production_quantity, task.complete_quantity, factory.id 'factory.id', factory.`name` 'factory.name', workshop.id 'workshop.id', workshop.`name` 'workshop.name', production_line.id 'production_line.id', production_line.`name` 'production_line.name' FROM mes_building_task task LEFT JOIN mes_building_factory factory ON factory.id = task.factory_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop workshop ON workshop.id = task.workshop_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line production_line ON production_line.id = task.production_line_id where task.product_id=#{productId} and task.product_type=#{productType}
